subject: Call for a demo of machine learning using R

messages.author: e69f535ef1b398f1
messages.subject: Call for a demo of machine learning using R
parts:
Hi R users.
A month ago I was one of the organizers of a Machine Learning on Big Data Meetup in Herzliya.
Part of the feedback we got was people wishing to get more hands-on demonstrations.
If any of you can (and wishes to) give a demo (about an hour long) of using R for machine learning,
showing the steps you do with a data set (public or one you can openly show),
from data exploration to building some classifier/recommender/clustering,
please contact me.
The intended audience are members of the IGTCloud Meetup, mostly programmers but also product, operations
and other managers from hi-tech companies.
As the meetup had a nice turnout, I believe such an event may also attract a large audience.
Thanks,
Yuval Feinstein (fyuval at gmail dot com)
